note: Parameters of the strict pilot runs written by pipeline/scripts/build.py. They are build CONVENTIONS, not market facts: each result-affecting one states its basis here and is stored in every run's `parameters`. Change them here (never in code) and rebuild.

basis.mode: Strict: no assumption of any kind may enter a result that is called verified.
basis.min_review: Only validated records count; unreviewed data is exploration (run with min_review='unreviewed' by hand, never in this build).
basis.labor_basis: Private pilot work: statistical wage plus separately sourced burdens. Prevailing wages are for public works only.
basis.labor_statistic: OEWS mean is the statistic the register describes first; the median is the alternative. A convention for the pilot, to be revisited with real data.
basis.burden_base: Percent-of-wages burdens apply to the base wage (the statistical wage excludes fringe); 'wage_plus_fringe' is selectable.
basis.price_policy: Median across products of the per-product cost: one vote per product, so many observations of one SKU do not outweigh the market.
basis.annual_paid_hours: 52 weeks x 40 h = 2080 paid hours per full-time year. Only used to turn annual wage caps (Social Security, FUTA, UI, ETT) into hourly cost: rate x min(cap, hourly x hours) / hours. A convention until the company states its actual paid hours.
